note: Knob DIFF over the base puzzle-image (center-out). The base owns the single-src sprite contract, the photo+scrim fade-under, the modest GROW (transform:scale of .coverWrap), the never-fade headline and reduced-motion/narrow static fallback. This variant's engine (variant.js) ADDS a real Z-depth assemble: tiles wait scattered in CSS perspective and converge home from depth. Byte-faithful to pz3-depth-fly-in.html.

engine.model: depth-converge (Z-fly-in) — tiles wait in real CSS perspective Z-depth then converge to z=0
engine.depthScatterSpread: 36 + zNorm*60   (near tiles fly from further out)
engine.depthStagger: per-tile startAt = (zNorm * 0.16) * assembleEnd   (near tiles begin a hair later → converge from depth)
engine.cue: thin filling progress line (scaleX 0→1), NOT a count-up

skin.serif: Fraunces, Times New Roman, Georgia, serif
skin.wordmark: ghost serif 13vw across the top, rgba(239,231,218,0.30)
skin.fallback: static .fallback cover block for reduced-motion / narrow
